verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud communications SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk export, data-takeout feature or open-format export. The call-log read API and the general mention of 'data management' APIs are developer building blocks a user could use to build their own extraction, not a first-party export-everything capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
